_anonymised_copy: Anonymised copy of a registered protocol file: internal provenance fields (storage ids, hosts, resource accounting, internal review notes) were removed or redacted. Embedded sha256 values refer to the original registered file and do not match this copy.
nature: REGISTERED AMENDMENT to the robustness track: a confirmatory replication probe (R2) of a contrast first seen post hoc on R1. It reuses the official MultiTQ test split; the original registered R1 results are never changed.
plan: PAKDD 2027 strengthening item A (registered 2026-10-29): confirmatory role-robustness probe. Device: the GPU host GPU 0 only.
question: On a fresh, disjoint sample of rewritten MultiTQ test questions, produced by a different generator family and confirmed by the authors' blinded human review, does the guided reader G_k lose more Hits@1 under rewriting than the LLM parser P_k (drop(G_k) - drop(P_k) > 0) at k = 1, 5 and 100?

motivation_post_hoc.source: robustness_posthoc_parser_vs_reader.csv; analysts' post-hoc analysis of R1 frozen predictions 427b2b3d on the 569 R1 LLM-judge-accepted rewrites; paired Poisson bootstrap B = 2000, seed 0
motivation_post_hoc.status: POST HOC on R1 (not registered there); it motivates H1-H3 and is not evidence for them

sample.recipe: r2_common.draw_sample_r2: largest-remainder allocation proportional to the candidate set's qtype counts; within each qtype (sorted order) quids sorted ascending; ONE numpy default_rng(20261029) generator, choice(n_qtype, alloc, replace=False) (same procedure as R1 rob_common.draw_sample)

pool.recipe: R1 pool procedure: largest remainder over the R2 sample's qtype counts; default_rng([20261029, 3]).choice within each qtype

sample.records: quid lists and sha256 (json.dumps(sorted int quids)) written to multitq_robustness_R2_perturbed_set.json; disjointness from R1 asserted

generator.model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ (official Qwen open-weights 4-bit AWQ build of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct): a model family different from the R1 generator (API LLM, API LLM) and from the Llama-3.1-8B backbone of the arms
generator.engine: vLLM 0.10.2 (tkgqa-vllm:latest), ONE RTX PRO 6000 (the GPU host GPU 0, pinned), dtype float16, max_model_len 2048, gpu_memory_utilization 0.90, enforce_eager; r2_gen.py
generator.prompt: one user turn = R1 rob_common.GEN_PROMPT (sha256 f69b6053645b90116e4418f53babafbd7e40f9e59f0b801bfaae16054353ea0d) with the question; the model's own default chat template (rendered prefix and template sha256 recorded)
generator.retry_policy: R1 policy: at most 2 attempts; attempt 2 only for pool questions whose attempt-1 rewrite failed a mechanical check or the judge; attempt 2 = GEN_PROMPT + GEN_RETRY_SUFFIX (sha256 d80d677031892fa7f2f153259836914eb126f90154096570af600490290d03ba) showing the rejected attempt-1 text; first accepted attempt kept
generator.engine_smoke_test: allowed before the first R2 generation: the 5 smallest train quids (questions/train.json), GEN_PROMPT, same engine; outputs discarded and never used; only checks that the engine loads and returns text on sm_120
generator.fallback: If the AWQ build cannot be downloaded, cannot load or fails the smoke test on GPU 0, the generator falls back to meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (already cached on the GPU host) in a single-card configuration, recorded as an amendment (with the failure evidence) BEFORE any R2 generation is run. No R2 generation may be run with any other model.

judge_prefilter: R1 judge prompt (rob_common.JUDGE_PROMPT, sha256 da40535e53be1f24a5c23e7dcc81ff2aa90580e7f0c3a8adc4b0921da4c7405a) and judge role (API LLM judge, JUDGE_MODEL_ID, max_tokens 200); called only on mechanically valid rewrites; judge-accepted iff all five booleans true. Used only as a pre-filter.

analysis_sets.PRIMARY: judge-accepted rewrites that the authors' blinded human review confirms: a row is kept iff same_answer_set = Y AND same_constraint_time = Y on EVERY returned reviewer sheet ('unsure', N or blank = not kept)
analysis_sets.LOW_N_flag: if the PRIMARY set has fewer than 200 questions, H1-H3 are still computed and labelled, and the result is flagged LOW_N

review_kit_R2: same format as the R1 kit: sheet (review_id, original_question, rewrite, qtype, gold_answers, same_answer_set, same_constraint_time, notes, reviewer_initials) with no predictions, judge output or generator identity; fixed random order numpy default_rng(20261029).permutation over the judge-accepted quids in ascending order; separate key; gold json; adapted instructions; rescoring script implementing H1-H3 and the secondaries; tests on R1 data and synthetic data only

list: S_1, S_5, S_100 (3 S seeds each)
P_1, P_5, P_100 (3 S seeds each)
arms.frozen: the R1 frozen adapters/models only (sha256 as in the R1 freeze and expected_sha.json); no retraining; RULE_k comes out of the structural rebuild and is descriptive only
arms.pipeline: identical to R1: rob_build.py (structural rebuild + bundles), frozen gk_infer.py (G, GU), frozen gu_retrieve.py, frozen pk_infer.py + pk_execute.py (tau off, fallback = the variant's S_k lists); R1 remote script sha256 recorded in the R2 freeze
arms.inputs: ORIG = all 2,000 sample questions (original text, re-run); RW = every judge-accepted rewrite (synthetic quid 10*quid + 3)
arms.drop_reference: drop = Hits@1(ORIG re-run) - Hits@1(RW) per question; S and P per-question hits are means over their 3 S seed files; G and GU seed 0

blinding: All arms run on ORIG and RW; a sha256 freeze of every prediction file is written and saved as an artifact BEFORE any review sheet comes back. No Hits/accuracy on R2 originals or rewrites is computed by anyone on this track until the analysts sends the returned sheets. Gold-free checks (identity, invalid/fallback rates, acceptance counts, template novelty) are allowed.

hypotheses.statistic: per-question d_i = drop(G_k)_i - drop(P_k)_i; paired Poisson(1) bootstrap of mean(d), B = 10,000, seed 20261029 (r2_common.primary_tests; multitq_eval stream; the same weights for the three k because n and seed are shared); one-sided p = share of bootstrap means <= 0; also two-sided 95% percentile CI and one-sided 95% lower bound
hypotheses.labels: CONFIRMED iff Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05; else NOT_CONFIRMED (per k). No effect-size margin.

secondary_descriptive: P_k - GU_k at k = 1, 100: rewrite Hits@1 gap and drop difference
per-arm drops with the R1 labels BRITTLE / ROBUST / INCONCLUSIVE (r2_common.drop_label: B = 2000, seed 0, two-sided 95% CI)

R1+R2 pooled estimates of drop(G_k) - drop(P_k): concatenation of the R1 set (R1 human-confirmed rows if the R1 review sheets are available at R2 scoring, else the 569 R1 judge-accepted rewrites; stated) and the R2 PRIMARY set; B = 10,000, seed 20261029
all of the above and H1-H3 also on the SENSITIVITY set
secondary results use the same bootstrap (B = 10,000, seed 20261029) unless stated; two-sided CIs; no multiplicity correction
identity_checks_gold_free: as R1: I1 ORIG structural rebuild vs frozen test files (top-1 >= 99.5% required, else STOP_PIPELINE_DRIFT with one logged bug-fix), I2 ORIG LLM re-run top-1 agreement vs frozen test predictions (flag < 98%), I3 GU retrieval identity

stop_rules.STOP_GPU_SHARING: use the GPU host GPU 0 only; before each dispatch check nvidia-smi and docker ps; wait while GPU 0 has a foreign compute process; never use GPU 1 and never stop another process; if GPU 0 cannot do the job, message the parent
stop_rules.STOP_HOST: resume from on-disk stage outputs; no partial scoring
stop_rules.STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY: adapter / frozen-code / prediction sha256 mismatch stops the run or the scoring
stop_rules.STOP_GENERATOR: generator fallback only through a pre-generation amendment (generator.fallback)
stop_rules.DEADLINE: all R2 compute finished by Fri 6 Nov 2026; unfinished items NOT_RUN

scoring_discipline: Scoring happens once, after the analysts returns the review sheets, with the R2 rescoring script on the frozen predictions; the original registered R1 results are never changed; every R2 analysis is labelled REGISTERED_AMENDMENT_R2 (primary, secondary) or POST_HOC (anything not listed here).
